listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference to energy-intensity indicators in the chemical industry (BPT benchmarking) — cited comparator, not the study context
listed_sector_signals.quote: Energy intensity indicators in the chemical industry are calculated with regard to the Best Practice Technology (BPT) available; e.g. total energy consumption versus BPT.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference to a chemical plant energy-efficiency (EE) index method by Song et al. — cited method only
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Song et al. (2014) describe the energy efficiency (EE) index of a chemical plant as the ratio of
target (Best Practice) energy consumption over actual energy consumption.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Cited reference to a performance-based energy-efficiency indicator for glass manufacturing plants (Boyd 2009) — bibliographic mention only
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Boyd, G., Development of a performance-based industrial energy efficiency indicator for glass 
manufacturing plants, 2009, Technical Report.

one_line: The paper develops and applies energy KPIs (EnPC, CUSUM, normalised data) in a discrete, batch-based Medical Devices production facility, tracking production steps and value streams; chemical-industry and glass-plant references appear only as cited comparators.
